title: Japanese-Style Egg Noodle Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired noodle dish made with egg noodles, light Australian sauce, and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Cook the egg noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Australian light sauce and 1 tablespoon of water.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the green onions, bean sprouts, and cabbage. Cook, stirring frequently, for 4-5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Push the vegetables to one side of the skillet. Crack in the eggs and scramble them until cooked through.
Mix the eggs with the vegetables.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir in the Australian light sauce mixture.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated.
Serve hot and garnish with additional green onions if desired.
